description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts to execute code on Windows systems.
detection_clues: Unusual PowerShell execution, encoded commands, suspicious command-line arguments, and unexpected script activity.
analyst_guidance: Review Sysmon Event ID 1, process command-line arguments, parent process, user account, and execution time.

description: Adversaries may repeatedly attempt authentication to guess valid account credentials.
detection_clues: Repeated failed logins, multiple authentication attempts, unusual login patterns, and attempts against multiple accounts.
analyst_guidance: Review authentication logs, source IP addresses, targeted accounts, failure frequency, and successful logins following failures.

description: Adversaries may use legitimate account credentials to gain access and maintain access to systems.
detection_clues: Unusual login locations, unexpected login times, abnormal account activity, and suspicious use of privileged accounts.
analyst_guidance: Verify account ownership, login history, source addresses, privilege level, and whether the activity matches normal user behavior.

description: Adversaries may abuse command and scripting interpreters to execute commands and scripts.
detection_clues: Unexpected command interpreter execution, suspicious scripts, unusual process chains, and abnormal command-line activity.
analyst_guidance: Inspect process creation logs, command-line arguments, parent-child process relationships, and execution context.

description: Adversaries may use Remote Desktop Protocol to access and control remote systems.
detection_clues: Unexpected RDP connections, unusual remote logins, suspicious source addresses, and abnormal remote session activity.
analyst_guidance: Review Windows authentication events, RDP logon events, source IP addresses, account activity, and session timing.
